authored_by: OpenHands AI agent on behalf of user
structural_rule: Any definitive gate failure stops costly remaining gates; unknown is not failure. Evidence-backed unavailable external contract is blocker.

accuracy.image_policy: All image-bearing inputs must reach model; byte hashes audited; no no-image controls.
accuracy.metric: Only declared native binary verifier outcomes; never reconstructed graded proxies.
accuracy.denominator: Every attempted task; missing answers and agent budget exhaustion zero. Infrastructure failures retained and disclosed, never excluded. Unattempted tasks remain explicit unresolved.
accuracy.pilot: Existing n10 diagnostic only; new cohort independent runs, no reuse. Existing pilot overlap disclosed.
accuracy.inference: At most 3 looks: two-sided Wilson 98.333333% interval (Bonferroni 0.05/3), paper-cluster bootstrap same confidence where paper groups available, 100000 replicates seed20260814. Require agreement; missing paper IDs invalidate population-independent confidence claim.
accuracy.fail: Entire CI <=0.10 or >=0.70. Full population point estimate outside open band fails finite-population gate.
accuracy.stop: Stop on structural/verifier fail or conclusive accuracy interval; otherwise expand only at prespecified looks. At full population disclose finite benchmark vs stochastic agent uncertainty.
accuracy.matcha_selection: Existing frozen manifest100 sha256 below; first100 fixed before these runs. Subsequent deterministic sha256 qualification-v1:task_id ordering among unselected IDs.
accuracy.csm_selection: Lowest SHA256 qualification-v1:file_name across pinned metadata; freeze IDs before execution.

verifier_audit.separation: Parser contract audit is not scientific gold audit. Independent adjudication must use figure/source evidence, blinded to gold before decision, with correct/incorrect classes and adversarial perturbations.
verifier_audit.rates: FP=accepted independently wrong/independently wrong; FN=rejected independently correct/independently correct. Each strictly <15%; uncertainty and ambiguous labels disclosed.
verifier_audit.unavailable_expertise: Do not fabricate scientific labels or infer verifier rates from solver accuracy.

binary_contracts: MATRIX/Omni/BioReason-Pro must have defensible native binary semantics before accuracy run; absence of official graded-to-binary mapping cannot be repaired by relabeling proxy.
